status: Workflow feedback fixes implemented and exact Windows package validated; development candidate in draft PR awaiting tester acceptance; not a published release
scope: Follow-up to tester feedback on explicit workflow input ownership, chaining, native navigation/rendering, first-use pack manager and scientific tool discoverability.

sourceChecks.scope: Local 75-check run used Python 3.12.14. The final CI build independently reran the same 75 suites on Linux; their Python/model sources were unchanged by the intervening canvas and gate-only commit.

attempts.windowsResult: UI gate failed before GUI launch; eight packaged host checks and eight reference/update checks passed per path. Not a UI pass.
attempts.failure: Exact raw SAM-text comparison rejected equivalent floating tag text (de:f:0.0100 versus de:f:0.01) after successful native BAM conversion. Gate now compares mandatory columns and typed tag values, using IEEE single-precision representation for f tags.
attempts.independentDiagnostic: Decoded actual BAM independently: 202 records, 50 differences confined to trailing zeros in equivalent floating tags. Corrected comparison accepts these records and rejects injected flag/tag-value mutations.

attempts.reason: Corrected typed scientific comparison; fractional high-resolution wheel accumulation; expanded explicit-source pointer connection regression. See finalCandidate for exact artifacts/reports.

limits: Physical Precision Touchpad pinch requires tester hardware; synthetic wheel and native gesture implementation are not physical-device validation.
No manual tester acceptance of these fixes yet.
No 0.8.0 release tag or published release created.
Candidate updater is scoped to 0.6.0 to 0.8.0; no 0.7.0 migration claim. Use the starter in a separate folder for review.
Native coverage is Windows Server 2022 at 96 DPI on a 1024x768 runner display; multi-monitor/high-DPI movement and native folder-picker interaction are not counted as passed.
Observed app bounds were 1044x788 and 1044x740, not the larger requested dimensions.
Source/build companion is immutable at tested commit. Later documentation/evidence updates do not change tested application bytes.

concurrencyReview.branchUpdates: Compare-and-swap expected_sha checks; no forced update or release replacement.
concurrencyReview.independentSourceReview: Separate agents reviewed explicit-input ownership, canvas integration, precision wheel state and scientific semantics. Modal snapshot lifetime, contextual reference selection and history zoom defects were fixed before the final package.

visualReview.findings: One reference input owns its file field; connected tool shows source identity without duplicating that file editor. Source-to-tool edge and zoom controls are visible; inspected scrolled text is clean.
visualReview.independentReview: Reviewer inspected ordinary connected-input, ordinary tool-delete hover, spaces source-delete hover, spaces 83% zoom, ordinary scrolled text and spaces first-open manager. No blocking overlap/rendering issue or duplicated workflow file editor found; all 36 workspace screenshot hashes independently verified. Root and gate agent also verified all 20 References captures, for 56 total.
visualReview.scope: Screenshot inspection plus automated pixel comparison, not human tester acceptance.
